title: CHANGE NOTICE FOR MANUAL NO. 07-04, Certification & Authorization

sections.title: CHANGE NOTICE FOR MANUAL NO. 07-04, CERTIFICATION & AUTHORIZATION
DATE:
sections.content_text:
Manual:
Aged, Blind, and Disabled Medicaid
Change No:
07-04
To:
County Directors of Social Services
Effective:
October 1, 2003

sections.title: I. BACKGROUND
sections.content_text: Currently, MA-2350, Certification and Authorization, and MA-500, Classification, are not the same in establishing authorization dates for cases with excess reserve.

sections.title: II. CONTENT OF CHANGE
sections.content_text: MA-2350, Certification and Authorization, has been revised to instruct the IMC to authorize the day reserve is reduced to the allowable limits as stated in MA-500, Classification.
